en: "Kine..."{w}
note: Tarzen says Kine-sama. Rendered as the plain name (cf. the Hess convention); 'Master'/'Lady' avoided: Tarzen dropped 'Master' in 5943 (slice 027) and Kine's gender is not fixed by the script. Align with slice 027's choice for 5943.

en: "Well, you've come all this way.{w}If that's what you want, I'll expel you right here, today."{w}{p}"Tarzen, you are...{w}
note: Hamon = expulsion from master's school; 'expel' used throughout (slice 027 has the same word). Last page is cut mid-sentence and resumes in 5970.

en:
{0E}"Tarzen, you are...{0F}
EXPELLEEEEED!!"{w}
note: The {0E}..{0F} part re-shows the end of 5968 verbatim, as in the source.

en: "Th-thank you very much...!!"{w}
"So, by the waaay..."{w}
Kine sidled up to the disciple with a leering grin.{w}
"Y-yes, what is it?"{w}
"Heerdahl's a place full of all sorts of fun grown-up amusements, ain't it?"{w}{p}"Well? Any pretty girls there?{w}Isn't there some girl you're sweet on?{w}Eh? Ehhh~~~~???"{w}
"C-come on, what does it matter?! Stuff like that..."{w}
note: Editorial: "what does it matter" (idiomatic for iijanai desu ka).

en: Press: "The woman who was next to you?"
note: Choice prompt; the party presses Tarzen about a woman seen beside Tarzen (in Heerdahl). Tarzen's gender is not settled, so no pronoun.

en: "H-hey, you idiot!"{w}
note: Tarzen to the party, who just raised the woman.

en:
"So there is one!? There is, isn't there!?
Why, you lucky dog!!{w}Kyeeeeeeeh!!"{w}
note: Kine's trademark shriek kieee rendered 'Kyeeeh'; keep consistent with slice 027. | Editorial: "So there is one!?" answers Kine's own question in 5979; bare "There is!?" read clipped.

en: Tarzen has gone red all the way to the ears.{w}

"They each have their own reasons for working there, but...
they're all good girls."{w}
"I see, I see.{w}Hyeh heh heh~"{w}
note: Editorial: Kine's laugh aligned with slice 027 5914 ("Hyeh heh heh!").

en: Kine watched Tarzen with a gentle smile.{w}

"Now I've no regrets left..."{w}{p}"But that evil spirit of Contrachio...{w}Try as I might, I just can't sense any truly evil will from that one."{w}{p}"If anything, that one seems full of rage and sorrow, like a vengeful god..."{w}
note: kiyatsu = 'that one' (neutral; Kine does not know who the spirit is). tatari-gami = 'vengeful god'. Subject restored in the last page. | Editorial: "Try as I might" for doumo (was "No matter what", unidiomatic here).

en:
"Kyeeeeeh!!
Now that's an interesting-looking toy you've got!"{w}
Kine seems interested in your Beldoll.{w}
"Why not let me have a go at it?"{w}
Kine set to work on the Beldoll...{w}
{0E}Kine is working at it...{0F}{w}
note: Build-up sequence: each row's {0E}..{0F} part repeats the previous row's full text, then adds a new tail. English keeps that exact chaining for all five challengers.

en: {0E}Kine is working at it...{0F}...?{w}
{0E}Kine is working at it......? {0F}...{w}
{0E}Kine is working at it......? ...{0F}...!!{w}
The Beldoll came partly undone!!{w}
"How's that, youngster?{w}I've still got it! Hyeh hyeh hyeh!"{w}
note: Editorial: o-wakai no = "youngster" and the same laugh as slice 027 (5872/5877/5916, 5914).

en: Raizam
"Mogu?{w}That looks like a fun toy you've got there, mogu?"{w}
Raizam seems interested in your Beldoll.{w}
"Lend it to me for a sec, moguuu!"{w}
note: Source uses mogu as Raizam's first-person word here (mogu ni kasu = lend it to Mogu); rendered 'me' to avoid reading 'Mogu' as another character. Alternative: 'Lend it to Mogu'.

en: Raizam set to work on the Beldoll...{w}
{0E}Raizam is working at it...{0F}{w}
{0E}Raizam is working at it...{0F}...?{w}
{0E}Raizam is working at it......? {0F}...{w}
{0E}Raizam is working at it......? ...{0F}...!!{w}
"I did it, moguuu!{w}That's one of the Four Sages for you! Impressed, moguuu!?"{w}
note: Shiken-ja, osoreitta ka: Raizam (Earth Sage) boasting.

en: Goblin Prince
"Hm?{w}That looks like an interesting toy you've got, huh?"{w}
Goblin Prince seems interested in your Beldoll.{w}
"Here, let me have a go at it!"{w}
Goblin Prince set to work on the Beldoll...{w}
{0E}Goblin Prince is working at it...{0F}{w}
{0E}Goblin Prince is working at it...{0F}...?{w}
{0E}Goblin Prince is working at it......? {0F}...{w}
{0E}Goblin Prince is working at it......? ...{0F}...!!{w}
"I did iiiit!{w}Don't you look down on Goblins!!!"{w}
"Oh my?{w}What an interesting toy you have there."{w}
Mistress seems interested in your Beldoll.{w}
"Won't you let me do it too?"{w}
note: Katakana yarasete carries a sexual double meaning; 'let me do it' keeps it. Mistress's gender is not stated: no pronouns.

en: Mistress set to work on the Beldoll...{w}
{0E}Mistress is working at it...{0F}{w}
{0E}Mistress is working at it...{0F}...?{w}
{0E}Mistress is working at it......? {0F}...{w}
{0E}Mistress is working at it......? ...{0F}...!!{w}
"How was that?{w}There's no toy that can hold out against my fingerwork, you know. ...Tee-hee."{w}
note: yubi-zukai = finger technique; innuendo kept.

en: Mistress slid those silky fingertips lightly across your cheeks.{w}
"Huh?{w}What's that you've got in your hand?"{w}
Urna seems interested in your Beldoll.{w}
"Ooh, a puzzle ring!? Looks like fun!{w}Gimme, gimme! I wanna try toooo!!"{w}
note: chie no wa = puzzle ring (the Beldoll is one).

en: Urna set to work on the Beldoll...{w}
{0E}Urna is working at it...{0F}{w}
{0E}Urna is working at it...{0F}...?{w}
{0E}Urna is working at it......? {0F}...{w}
{0E}Urna is working at it......? ...{0F}...???{w}
note: Urna's attempt ends in '...???' (confusion) instead of '...!!', as in the source.

en: "...What the heck is this!{w}Screw this!!"{w}
note: fuzakenna: kept at full strength.

en: Urna slammed the Beldoll into the ground!!{w}
"Uh... huh?{w}......{w}H-hmph! How d'you like THAT!!!"{w}
note: The slam apparently solved it; Urna bluffs.

"Hello! Welcome to Semnadoc!"{w}{p}"My name's Namina. My dream is to train here in this town and become a fine Priest!"{w}
note: souryo = Priest (glossary class term).

en: "And then, once I'm a fine Priest, I'll work at Semnadoc Cathedral, and me and Lord Mersenne... ehehe~"{w}
note: Mersenne-sama -> 'Lord Mersenne' (male per glossary, script evidence). Deliberately trails off.

en:
"Lord Mersenne became Archbishop at such a young age, you know!
Look, look at this!"{w}
Namina showed you a multicolor woodblock-print card depicting Mersenne.{w}
"It was made for tourists, but it's my treasure!"{w}
"Oh, hello, everyone. Lovely weather again today!{w}Adventuring is full of danger, isn't it?{w}I stay inside the town, so I'm safe, but..."{w}
As you were talking with Namina, Mersenne passed by on the way to the Cathedral.{w}
note: Editorial: "the Cathedral" capitalised as in slice 029-030 (Semnadoc Cathedral).
